reviews.title: It’s an okay subscription based app but almost feels lazy in a lot of aspects
reviews.text:
App feels generic and lack of content for what you pay for. I would say the older layout was way better but that still lacked content aswell. 

Here’s some examples:

-Resources tab is limited and is filled common knowledge with some google searching.

-Protection tab doesn’t work well in limiting access (just use Covenant eyes)

-panic room is very generic and severely lacks content. The “game” to distract you is literally dodging pornsites basically informing you what options you have to access it. Just not well thought off. Prayer and community could be expanded on. 

Finally only being able to check in once a day and not have an exact time relapse timer instead just doesn’t make since for a streak app.  

Overall it’s just okay but for what you pay there could be a lot more done with this app with supporting people who are dealing with addiction. I hate to say but it seems more about making money than helping others.

reviews.title: Break free
reviews.text: This app is by far the best thing that has ever been made since sliced bread. All jokes aside a corn addiction is probably the worst type of addiction you can have because it is eating you alive and you don’t even realize it. It is also very far up on the list of hardest addictions to quit because once you start consuming this type of content the damage has already been done and it can be extremely hard to quit. This app is great because it keeps you accountable and adds a content blocker on your device. It also gives you ways and coaching on helping you break the addiction. If you are struggling with this addiction then I would highly recommend this app.

reviews.title: It’s OK
reviews.text: The app functions fine and is a great tool to help stop your addiction. But I feel the developers are lazy. The app isn’t intuitive, or interactive at all. Same check in questions every day that don’t (but should) change some to reflect your unique struggles for that day. Example: When rating your struggles for the day, if you input a zero, it still proceeds to ask what your biggest temptation was. If I didn’t already pay for the lifetime subscription, I’d have gone with a different app.

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: This app doesn’t work right. If you fail and have to start your streak over, the app will restart back to zero which it should but as soon as you go out and enter back into app, it restates to however many days you’ve had the app! It doesn’t keep track it just counts days even if you don’t enter anything! The streak should start over if you tell it you’ve relapsed! Also, the question don’t even make sense. It asked if you watched porn today. If you say yes (or no) it will ask about your urges. Then it will give you a multiple choice question. The question is something like “did you experience any strong urges” the three option are “yes but I resisted” “mild urges only” and “ no urges at all” well what if you had urges and didn’t resist!?! There is no option for that. Why are they even asking these question because they have no point if you can even enter what actually happen. Poor Ui experience and app freezes and just need work. I do not recommend this app!
